answer_4.quote: While human evaluation provides a more reliable alternative, it is costly and difficult to set up
answer_4.guideline: The INLG 2021 accuracy evaluation shared task carefully annotated 60 outputs of various neural systems trained on Rotowire with 6 error types (see Table ) defined in . The objective of the shared task is then to either implement an automatic metric for creating the same type of annotations automatically, or to develop a human evaluation scenario capable of producing the same annotations while requiring less resources.
